caption: Save for your next Tokyo trip! 🎂Celebrated my solo birthday last year at a hidden gem Tokyo cafe where they serve edible Mount Fuji cakes. . 🗻Thought it was gonna be awkward but it was worth the effort!!  The cakes are delicate and came with a whole collection. Don’t forget to check merchs, even their to-go boxes are well designed too🤌🏻 . 🎀RSVP, but walk-ins are welcome too. (The website’s a little old-school) I was super nervous to spend my first solo birthday there, but the staff were so friendly and helpful🥹 . #tokyo #tokyocafe #tokyorev #tokyoeats #foodietiktok #foodietoks #japantravel #japanfoodie #japanitinerary #placestovisitinjapan #aestheticcafe #thingstodointokyo #tokyofood  #solobirthday #awkwardmoments #softgirlvibes#birthdayvlog #hiddengemtokyo #hiddengemjapan #mountfuji#japanesedessert #aestheticcake#tokyodessert #travelmoments #solotravel
transcript: No one really talks about how awkward it is to ask for your own birthday cake. After missing Mount Fuji in real life, I found this whimsical cafe. They're known for edible mountain cakes, each one inspired by Japanese peaks. The inside felt like vintage dollhouse, cozy, retro, and just the right amount of weird with seasonal flavors and ridiculous attention to detail. What's retro isn't just their interior, but also their website. After 20 minutes of struggling, I finally booked a birthday tea set with a note from Mount Fuji. But when I got there, they brought me a panacotta. It was cute quickly, but after all the effort, I couldn't let it go, so I stood up and asked. Thankfully, the staff came back with Mount Fuji in her hand and a candle on top. I forgot to make a wish because I was just proud that I said something and recovering from the awkwardness. So if you're into unique cafes in Tokyo, this one's worth saving because.
